## Passage or source
Which view, lesson, claim ID, or source URL needs attention? Copy a short passage if helpful.

## What needs correcting?
Describe the error, uncertainty, missing credit, or broken link.

## Supporting evidence
Include a source link or bibliographic reference and an exact page/section when available. If you cannot access the source, say so; a suspected problem is still worth reporting.

## Suggested wording (optional)

## Context (optional)
Build/commit, browser, or steps to reproduce a navigation problem. Please omit personal messages and participant notes.
